gary_2026_09_15_tech_x_market_decoders.title: Tech x Market Decoders
gary_2026_09_15_tech_x_market_decoders.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_09_15_tech_x_market_decoders.summary: Gary's Guide: We decode tech & market signals together - so you can operate, invest, & decide better. Every week, we pick one topic - a company or startup everyone's talking about, a technology reshaping an industry, or a shift in how things are being built or bought. Bring your laptop. Here's how it works: 6 pm - check-in. We kick off at 6.15 pm. 15-20 minutes - decode solo. Quiet research time. Dig into the news, the product, the tech stack, the data. No talking, just thinking. 35-40 minutes - decode together. We open the floor. What did you find? Where do you disagree? What's convincing, what's overhyped, what would change your mind? This is where judgment actually gets built - not from reading alone, but from testing your read against someone else's. Last few minutes - wrap up. You'll leave with a sharper read on the topic than you walked in with, & a few new perspectives you hadn't considered. That's the whole point. This week's topic: Hugging Face - the hack, Microduck & acquisition by Nvidia Hugging Face's busy months - hacked by an OpenAI model, launching a $399 robot duck, & reportedly being bought by Nvidia for $12.9B. We're decoding what it all means for the future of AI. Come as you are - operator, investor, builder, or just someone who reads too much tech or business news & wants to discuss with smart people.

gary_2026_09_17_superplane_elastic_ai_ag.summary: Gary's Guide: Software factories are here. AI agents write code, open PRs, run tests, deploy to production, & respond to incidents - all without waiting for a human to click a button. SuperPlane is the agent orchestrator that turns your tools into a software factory. Elastic is the observability engine that tells you what's happening inside it. This is an unconference, you bring the topics, we bring the structure (and drinks). Come with opinions about how far you'd let agents go. Date: Thursday, September 17th from 6:00-9:00 PM Location: Elastic NYC Office 1250 Broadway, Floor 16, Training Room New York, NY 10001 Some topics we would discuss: How much autonomy should agents have in production? Building the feedback loop: deploy observe respond learn Agents that fix what agents broke - is that a loop or a spiral? What does "human in the loop" actually mean when agents ship 10x faster? Observability as the control plane for your software factory From Kibana alert to automated rollback - what's your threshold? The trust problem: when do you stop reviewing agent PRs? About Elastic Elastic is the observability stack behind high-velocity engineering teams. With Elasticsearch, Kibana, & the rest of Elastic Stack, engineers, SREs & platform engineers get real-time visibility into logs, metrics, traces, & security events correlated in one place, not scattered across tools. As release cadence increases with the adoption of software factories, Elastic keeps you in control of what's running & why.
